description: This file defines an abstract class 'loc_xml' that extends 'source', providing a method to parse XML files into a SimpleXML object. It serves as a local XML data source within the SuiteCRM project, with security measures like disabling entity loading during XML parsing.

classes.name: loc_xml
classes.description: An abstract class for handling XML source parsing in SuiteCRM, extending the 'source' class and providing a method to parse XML files securely.

methods.name: _parse
methods.description: Reads the contents of a given file, disables external entity loading for security, and parses the XML contents into a SimpleXML object.
